card.name: Salt part of a drug name
card.fires_on: The word right after a drug's base name that begins its salt form, such as calcium or hydro (before chloride or bromide), and the middle of mesylate. It appears in label text on interactions and adverse reactions.

modes.label: Calcium salt
modes.description: The word calcium directly after atorvastatin.

modes.label: Hydro before chloride or bromide
modes.description: The start of hydrochloride or hydrobromide after a drug name.
modes.example: initiation of treatment with bupropion<< hydro>>bromide extended-release tablets

modes.label: Inside mesylate
modes.description: The middle piece of mesylate after a drug name.
modes.example: imatinib mes<<yl>>ate tablets have a weak inhibitory effect
